summary: Selected 5 executed Industrial rent comps in Columbus dated between 2026-02-05 and 2026-06-09 and within 1.72 miles. Effective net rents (undiscounted, per client convention) range from $9.468 to $22.123 per sf per year. Two additional executed leases qualified but were not included due to the top-5-by-distance rule. One executed lease (R3746) was excluded because its evidence was published after the 2026-08-31 cutoff. A comp-grid XLSX with citations has been created (artifacts/underwriting-v2.xlsx).
limitations: Undiscounted rent-only convention used; no present-value or downtime/leasing costs beyond free rent and TI.
Free months were assumed to occur at lease commencement; none of the selected comps had free periods long enough to span an annual escalation step.
Gross expense deductions were treated as flat per year with no escalation, per instructions.
Some records lacked required fields (term, TI, gross expenses) and could not be evaluated.
Duplicate handling relied on shared entity_id to identify the same underlying lease.
Executed amendments or drafts published/effective after the cutoff were not applied.
